The '''AS23 aerial survey droid''' was a flying [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used for airborne exploring. It was manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]].

==Characteristics==
The AS23 was triangular and streamlined. It was designed to easily slip through the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] while it performed its duties. Its shape was reminiscent of a wide variety of airborne predators, which often caused the local wildlife to leave it alone during missions. It cost 23,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new.

It had a sophisticated [[automap]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] package that allowed it to make topographical maps, even in total darkness. Information could be stored in the droid's databanks, or transmitted back to the owner via a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].

The AS23 could also be employed as an aerial spotter for [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]].
